dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Hmm. Ah, what would I do for a brilliant match, a flash of elegance that will inspire a new verse?

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Hmm... Perhaps you are the one I have been waiting for. Would you like to have a friendly spar?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Should we meet again, I will surely read you my new poem.

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: An honor and a pleasure! But I fear I need to give this verse a little more thought...

dialogues.speaker: Qingzhou
dialogues.text: Brilliant! Once I have completed this poem, I will send it to you as thanks for your aid.
